name: real-madrid-bedroom-selfie
image_purpose: Football fan lifestyle post and bedroom selfie visual

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic bedroom mirror selfie featuring split-dyed hair and a supplied Real Madrid jersey.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with long wavy hair split half jet-black and half platinum-blonde, straight bangs, soft doe eyes, winged eyeliner, and natural skin texture. She wears the exact white Real Madrid home soccer jersey with blue accents shown in the reference, a secure black athletic bottom, black hair tie, silver ring, and holds a matte pink smartphone while lying comfortably on a white bed with knees bent and feet raised in a relaxed pose.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 medium mirror-selfie composition on a white quilted comforter, large window with horizontal blinds and translucent curtains behind, muted blue-gray walls, white nightstand, accurate phone orientation and reflection. Preserve supplied jersey crest/markings without inventing new branding.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural backlight with gentle golden-hour rim on hair and shoulders, high-key interior fill, realistic skin texture and calm sporty-bedroom atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm look, f/2.8, 9:16, high-resolution digital photography, realistic jersey mesh, hair, bedding and skin texture, subtle grain, accurate mirror geometry.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic vertical 9:16 bedroom mirror selfie of one approved adult woman with long wavy hair split half jet-black and half platinum-blonde, straight bangs, soft doe eyes, winged eyeliner, and natural skin texture. She wears the exact white Real Madrid home soccer jersey with blue accents shown in the reference, a secure black athletic bottom, black hair tie, and silver ring, holding a matte pink smartphone while lying comfortably on a white quilted bed with knees bent and feet raised. Include a large window with horizontal blinds and translucent curtains, muted blue-gray walls, a white nightstand, accurate phone orientation and reflection, soft natural backlight, gentle golden rim, high-key fill, realistic jersey mesh and bedding texture, and casual sporty bedroom mood. Preserve supplied jersey crest/markings only from the reference.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, explicit body-part emphasis, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, invented or altered team crest, random text, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, broken reflection, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, watermark, low resolution, blur

assets.usage: Preserve approved adult identity, split hair, exact jersey and supplied crest, safe bed pose, phone, bedding, window, reflection, and lighting.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference. Preserve identity, outfit, supplied team markings, safe pose, phone, bedroom, reflection, and lighting. Do not invent or alter logos, crests, or typography; bedding and minor decor may be replaced. Any replacement person must be an approved adult.

changes: Clarified the subject as an approved adult, replaced extreme body-emphasis and string-bikini wording with a secure athletic bottom, and constrained team branding to the supplied reference.
